title: And / but / because
note: Basic linkers. Gap on and / but / because only. and=add · but=contrast · because=why. Soft accepts where natural (stay home / stay at home). · names diversified (Martin/Anna pool)

cards.title: And / but / because
cards.body: These words join ideas in one sentence.
cards.body_cz: Spojují dvě části věty. Jedno slovo = jedna práce.

cards.title: And
cards.body: and adds one more thing or action.
cards.body_cz: and = a. Přidáváš další věc nebo děj.
points: and = more of the same idea

cards.title: But
cards.body: but shows a different or opposite idea.
cards.body_cz: but = ale. Druhá část je jiná nebo proti.

cards.title: Because
cards.body: because gives a reason — answers why?

examples.en: I go to bed because I am tired.
I drink water because I am thirsty.

cards.title: Which linker?
points: Look at the job of the second part
Gap is only and · but · because
cards.body_cz: Přidat → and · Opak → but · Proč → because.

cards.title: Examples

examples.en: I go to bed because I am tired.

examples.cz: Petr má rád angličtinu a češtinu.

cards.body_cz: Stejná krátká A1 slova — mění se jen linker.

cards.title: Remember
points: Gap only on the linker — short A1 sentences
cards.body_cz: and = přidat · but = opak · because = proč. Nic jiného v mezeře.
